commands.label: claude-cli-gpg-tmpfs-shred
commands.note: Overwrite claude_cli_setup.sh: tmpfs /run/secrets + shred after decrypt. Update README with WSL2 pre-encrypt step. Unix LF.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path 'D:\claude_boot' | Out-Null; $sh = @('#!/bin/sh','# Alpine Linux - Claude CLI Setup with GPG Key Vault (tmpfs + shred)','# Usage: sh /media/usb/claude_boot/claude_cli_setup.sh','','USB=/media/usb/claude_boot','KEYFILE=$USB/api.key.gpg','','# Install packages','apk add --no-cache gnupg nodejs npm git curl coreutils','','# Install Claude CLI (skip if already installed)','command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code','','# Mount RAM disk for secret','mkdir -p /run/secrets','mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /run/secrets','','if [ -f "$KEYFILE" ]; then','  # Decrypt to RAM, shred source','  gpg -d "$KEYFILE" > /run/secrets/apikey 2>/dev/null','  shred -u "$KEYFILE"','  export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(cat /run/secrets/apikey)','  shred -u /run/secrets/apikey','else','  echo "No api.key.gpg found. Paste your Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...) then press Enter:"','  read -r APIKEY','  echo -n "$APIKEY" > /run/secrets/apikey','  gpg --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 -o "$KEYFILE" /run/secrets/apikey','  export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$APIKEY','  shred -u /run/secrets/apikey','  echo "Key encrypted to $KEYFILE"','fi','','umount /run/secrets','','if [ -z "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" ]; then','  echo "ERROR: API key empty. Delete $KEYFILE and re-run."','  exit 1','fi','','echo "Key loaded (RAM only). Starting Claude CLI..."','claude'); $text = $sh -join "`n"; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText('D:\claude_boot\claude_cli_setup.sh', $text + "`n", [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8); Write-Output 'SETUP_SH_TMPFS_OK'; $rm = @('ALPINE LINUX CLAUDE CLI - COMPLETE SETUP GUIDE','==============================================','Built: 2026-10-28 | Drive: D:\ (Ventoy USB)','','FILES','-----','  alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso  <- Ventoy boots this','  localhost.apkovl.tar.gz            <- auto-login overlay','  ventoy\ventoy.json                 <- 5s autoboot config','  claude_boot\claude_cli_setup.sh    <- PRIMARY: run after boot','  claude_boot\api.key.gpg            <- API key (GPG AES256 encrypted)','  claude_boot\README.txt             <- this file','','PRE-BOOT: ENCRYPT API KEY FROM WINDOWS (WSL2)','----------------------------------------------','  Run this ONCE in WSL2 before booting Alpine:','    echo "sk-ant-YOUR_KEY_HERE" | gpg --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 -o /mnt/d/claude_boot/api.key.gpg','  (enter a passphrase when prompted - remember it for Alpine boot)','','BOOT (STEP 1)','-------------','  F12 -> Ventoy USB -> Alpine (auto in 5s) -> root login automatic','','SETUP-ALPINE (STEP 2 - first time only)','---------------------------------------','  setup-alpine','    disk: none    lbu media: usb    (everything else: defaults)','','MOUNT USB (STEP 3)','------------------','  mkdir -p /media/usb','  mount /dev/sdb1 /media/usb  (try sdc1 if sdb is internal)','','RUN SCRIPT (STEP 4)','-------------------','  sh /media/usb/claude_boot/claude_cli_setup.sh','','  IF api.key.gpg exists: decrypts to RAM tmpfs -> shreds source -> exports key -> runs claude','  IF no key file: prompts for key -> encrypts to api.key.gpg -> runs claude','','SAVE (STEP 5)','-------------','  umount /media/usb && lbu commit','','SECURITY','--------','  - Key decrypted to tmpfs (/run/secrets) - never touches disk','  - Source api.key.gpg shredded after decrypt (re-encrypt next time)','  - OR: re-encrypt from WSL2 after each boot (safer)','  - Never store raw key in plain text'); $rt = $rm -join "`n"; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText('D:\claude_boot\README.txt', $rt + "`n", [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8); Write-Output 'README_TMPFS_OK'"
